decisions.reason: Although no longer clearly visible on the website, this two-component resin injection unit is closely tied to the firm's plural-component and injection knowledge, so management is more likely to retain and adapt it than abandon it quickly.

This resin injection unit also builds on the firm's core fluid-handling and application capabilities, and a medium-sized German machinery producer would typically use accumulated field feedback to refine it before exiting.

An automatic airless spray gun remains strongly related to the firm's long-established spray technology base, giving it the absorptive capacity to improve the product and support customers despite weaker later visibility.
A manual airless spray gun sits very near the center of the firm's existing product, service and spare-parts knowledge, so continued commercialization is still more likely than withdrawal.

Because this air-assisted airless spray gun line spans several models in one of the firm's core technology areas, management is likely to keep it as a platform for serving multiple customer specifications.

The data logger complements the equipment portfolio but is less aligned with the firm's traditional mechanical strengths, and after several years without clear market presence management is more likely to redeploy resources than continue a weaker digital niche.
